---
title: "Interactive Plots"
---

This page includes a simple interactive scatter plot so you can explore how vehicle weight and fuel efficiency change across cylinder groups.

<label for="cyl-filter"><strong>Filter by cylinders:</strong></label>
<select id="cyl-filter">
  <option value="all">All cars</option>
  <option value="4">4 cylinders</option>
  <option value="6">6 cylinders</option>
  <option value="8">8 cylinders</option>
</select>

<div id="mtcars-plot" style="height: 420px;"></div>

<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js"></script>
<script>
const cars = [
  { wt: 2.62, mpg: 21.0, cyl: 6, label: "Mazda RX4" },
  { wt: 2.875, mpg: 21.0, cyl: 6, label: "Mazda RX4 Wag" },
  { wt: 2.32, mpg: 22.8, cyl: 4, label: "Datsun 710" },
  { wt: 3.215, mpg: 21.4, cyl: 6, label: "Hornet 4 Drive" },
  { wt: 3.44, mpg: 18.7, cyl: 8, label: "Hornet Sportabout" },
  { wt: 3.46, mpg: 18.1, cyl: 6, label: "Valiant" },
  { wt: 3.57, mpg: 14.3, cyl: 8, label: "Duster 360" },
  { wt: 3.19, mpg: 24.4, cyl: 4, label: "Merc 240D" },
  { wt: 3.15, mpg: 22.8, cyl: 4, label: "Merc 230" },
  { wt: 3.44, mpg: 19.2, cyl: 6, label: "Merc 280" },
  { wt: 3.44, mpg: 17.8, cyl: 6, label: "Merc 280C" },
  { wt: 4.07, mpg: 16.4, cyl: 8, label: "Merc 450SE" }
];

function renderPlot(filterValue) {
  const filtered = filterValue === "all"
    ? cars
    : cars.filter((car) => String(car.cyl) === filterValue);

  Plotly.newPlot("mtcars-plot", [{
    x: filtered.map((car) => car.wt),
    y: filtered.map((car) => car.mpg),
    text: filtered.map((car) => `${car.label} (${car.cyl} cyl)`),
    mode: "markers",
    type: "scatter",
    marker: {
      size: 12,
      color: filtered.map((car) => car.cyl),
      colorscale: "Viridis"
    },
    hovertemplate: "%{text}<br>Weight: %{x}<br>MPG: %{y}<extra></extra>"
  }], {
    title: "Fuel efficiency compared with vehicle weight",
    xaxis: { title: "Weight (1000 lbs)" },
    yaxis: { title: "Miles per gallon" },
    margin: { t: 60, r: 20, b: 60, l: 60 }
  }, { responsive: true });
}

document.getElementById("cyl-filter").addEventListener("change", (event) => {
  renderPlot(event.target.value);
});

renderPlot("all");
</script>

## How this supports inquiry

- compare clusters for different groups
- look for association between two numerical variables
- discuss unusual values and whether they affect conclusions
